page: Microsoft Azure E64s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor with 32 physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions). The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64s_v6 demonstrates top-tier performance in memory-intensive and multi-threaded workloads. Its large-block memory bandwidth for both read and write operations ranks in the top 10% of tested systems, reflecting high resource density and efficient memory architecture. Multi-core performance is strong, as evidenced by top-tier Geekbench multi-core scores and Passmark physics tests. Database operations and static web serving throughput also achieve top-tier status, while Redis SET operations and single-threaded compression tasks show strong performance.

Given its high memory density and dedicated Intel Xeon compute resources, the E64s_v6 offers high qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage. The absence of bundled local storage allows organizations to scale storage independently via network-attached Premium Storage. This virtual machine is highly suited for memory-intensive applications, including large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and enterprise web serving.
